<thought>Search the template catalog for a retrosynthetic template that converts an aldehyde back to a carboxylic ester, matching the DIBAL‑H reduction (break a carboxylic ester, form an aldehyde and an aliphatic hydroxyl). Use acetaldehyde (CC=O) as a simple target molecule.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "CC=O",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["carboxylic esters"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["aldehydes", "aliphatic hydroxyls"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
